facts.fact: The present museum was an early19thcentury charitable institution serving orphaned children, older and vulnerable people.
Manuel Tolsá designed the building and José Gutiérrez constructed it; it opened in1810.
José Clemente Orozco painted the Capilla Mayor frescos between1937and1939, including El hombre de fuego.
The architecture has a symmetric Neoclassical layout with patios and arcaded passages.
The ensemble received UNESCO World Heritage designation in1997.
The current museum presents modern/contemporary exhibitions and cultural activities.
